spans.title: The Derelict Handbag
spans.blurb: On a misty November night, two friends pass a locked church and find a handbag abandoned in the dark porch, forced open by hands unknown.

spans.title: The Silent Passenger
spans.blurb: A train stands at a junction platform with one passenger who will never wake. Two sharp-eyed doctors sift the compartment for small clues before the police arrive.

spans.title: Thirty Thousand a Year
spans.blurb: A private soldier learns he has inherited a vast fortune, and watches his own master weep with envy. The money cannot buy back what he truly misses.

spans.title: The Glove and the Blue Ribbon
spans.blurb: At a tournament before Charlemagne, a victorious young knight sees a tiny glove tied with blue ribbon fall at his feet, and looks up.

spans.title: The Sorcerer and the Emperor
spans.blurb: A sorcerer walks unseen through a sleeping army camp, relieving an emperor of his sword, his crown, and his dignity, then offers to lead the pursuit.

spans.title: A Rope in the Lantern Light
spans.blurb: A wallet vanishes from a wagon camp at midnight. When the crowd finds it in a red-headed stranger's bag, someone quietly suggests a rope.

spans.title: A Visitor in a Thick Veil
spans.blurb: A businessman returns to his office and hears a lady waited an hour for him yesterday. He turns white, for he knows why that cannot be.

spans.title: Wake Up, I'm Here
spans.blurb: Helen slips past the screen to wake Lord Abbotsford, asleep by the fire, his table laid out with banknotes, diamonds, and her only photograph.

spans.title: Three Shots at Dawn
spans.blurb: A cowhand rigs a dummy of himself beside a disputed spring and beds down in the brush. At first light, a rifle speaks three times.

spans.title: The Parson Plays the Wheel
spans.blurb: A minister walks into a crowded saloon to settle an unusual bargain: the gambler sat through his sermon, so tonight the parson takes his turn at the wheel.

spans.title: Jonah and the Fox
spans.blurb: A weary prophet shares his supper with a polite fox, who has one small theological question that the Schools never quite answered.

spans.title: The Marriage Embassy
spans.blurb: A proud mother and her tongue-tied brother call on a prince with an audacious request on behalf of her son, the prophet.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals in advance that the prince refuses Jonah's hoped-for marriage to the Lady Judith.

spans.title: The O'Shea
spans.blurb: A handsome stranger in white drill studies a document through a monocle, until an old soldier across the room recognizes him and jumps up.
